scope: Evaluation metadata recomputation, cached/dataset image loading and sensitivity callback input precision
coverage: Actual float64 model prediction writes metadata with the expected class and confidence
Cached NPZ inputs and dataset fallback inputs retain an exactly checked float64-only input perturbation
The sensitivity callback passes float64 input to real autograd computation and returns the expected gradients
Parameterless models retain the input tensor dtype
limitations: Metric evaluation was mocked to inspect the input and invoke the actual callback; this test does not independently validate metric scores
Only synthetic CPU models and inputs were used; historical results were not recomputed
